description: Sample only (line top-1121-hpinclude, not used by any program): py/aos/apps/hook/loop_points.json rewritten in the user's 11-21 format - id as key, input / output as JSON Schema, every other key free. Hook points of anything run by aos-loop whose loop.json wires them: after_start and after_stop (on_start / on_stop), and before_run / after_run (on_before_run / on_after_run, each only while its _if flag file exists: STACK/hook_before_run.flag, hook_after_run.flag, kept by aos-agent hook and aos-hook); the templates wire all four through aos-hook fire.

after_start.description: the loop started, before the first run of its body (loop.json on_start; also after a wake or an auto_restart, not after a hard kill)
after_start.if_failed: the loop stops (all four loop points do): the body never runs, after_stop still fires

after_stop.description: the loop is about to exit (loop.json on_stop: stop, sleep, remove, shutdown, a failing run; not after a hard kill)

code.description: the code the loop exits with

signal.description: the signal it got, or null

cause.description: stop, sleep, remove, shutdown, stuck, signal, max, body_exit or error (copied as given); null when empty or unset

after_stop.if_failed: the loop exits with the hook's failure code when it would have exited 0 (all four loop points stop); when it already exits with another code, that code stays and the failure is one warning

before_run.description: before each run of the loop body, after the pause check and the wait for interval_ms

stage.description: fsm bodies only: the state about to run (the table's start state on the first run); null for bodies without states

before_run.subject: stage
before_run.if_blocked: the loop skips this run: the body does not run, the run is not counted, after_run does not fire; the loop asks again after interval_ms
before_run.if_failed: the loop stops, as after a failing run; the body does not run

after_run.description: after each run of the loop body, whatever its exit code (not when the body could not start, not when the loop got a signal)

counter_runs.description: which run this was (the same number before_run got)

signal.description: the signal that ended the body, or null

next_stage.description: fsm bodies only: the state the table is at now (the next one after a taken step, the same one otherwise); null for bodies without states

after_run.if_failed: the loop stops with the hook's code when the body exited 0; when the body itself ends the loop, the body's result counts and the hook failure is one warning
